name: SearXNG
label: SearXNG
description: SearXNG official API via OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). Operations: search. Docs: https://docs.searxng.org/dev/search_api.html. Official instance JSON API. JSON is off by default. You must point at an instance you are allowed to automate — public instances typically forbid bots. No default public instance. Secrets stay in configurationParameters. jobType custom-script-executor.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One SearXNG request. Set operation plus the fields that operation requires. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"search"}.

schema.label: categories
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `categories` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: instance_host
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `instance_host` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: language
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `language` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: pageno
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `pageno` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: q
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `q` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: safesearch
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `safesearch` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Secrets never echoed. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body (or raw text if not JSON). Never includes the API secret.

configurationParameters.label: Instance Host
configurationParameters.description: SearXNG host you operate or have permission to query (no scheme). Example: searx.example.com.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout seconds. Default 30. Keep under the daemon sandbox request budget.
